title: Ecos-Synthetica: The Evolutionary Shield
one_line: A 3D journey from a single cell to a human: meet fungi, bacteria, viruses and insects from their own side, then answer them the way life really does.
how_to_play: Move with WASD or the joystick, drag to look, tap or E to scan an organism; L opens the Synthesis Lab, C the Codex. English, Hindi or Bengali.
description: Fungi, bacteria, viruses, insects, algae, lichens and worms are not villains: each one is surviving, as you are. Scan 42 organisms to hear their side first: how they live, what they give the living world, what Earth would lose without them, and where their energy comes from and goes. Then answer them with the defences life really evolved, by combining real parts in the Synthesis Lab (70 parts, such as CRISPR memory and Cas nucleases against a phage). Countered species go into immune memory and return to their role in nature; partners raise the ecosystem balance, while heat, drought and cold lower it. Every profile shows how humans came to understand each one: belief, then observation, then science, with Indian history such as neem, turmeric, Ayurveda, J. C. Bose and Ronald Ross. Pass a short quiz to evolve from Single Cell to Plant Seedling, Honey Bee and Human. Read aloud, in English, Hindi and Bengali, on a phone or a computer.
